free_tier.stated: Tiny at $9.38 per month: 1 CPU core, 4 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD, 2 TB bandwidth, 1 IPv4, KVM with SSH access and a SolusVM panel. The vendor's own plan table lists, down the Tiny column, 'Pure SSD' 30 GB, 'Bandwidth' 2TB, 'RAM' 4GB, 'CPU Cores' 1, 'IP addresses' 1, and a price row of '$9.38 Per Month'. The cart (2026-11-07) offers 1, 3, 6 and 12-month terms priced $9.38, $28.14, $56.28 and $112.56 - exactly 1, 3, 6 and 12 times the monthly rate, so every term prices at the monthly rate with no prepay discount, the 12-month term totals $112.56, and the cart accepted the plan add with no stock warning. No renewal price is published. Starter is $18.99 per month with 50 GB, 2.5 TB, 8 GB RAM and 2 cores; Pro is $34.99 with 100 GB, 5 TB, 16 GB and 2 cores. The page prints a bare dollar sign and declares no currency anywhere in it, so the figure is recorded as $ and not as USD.

chaining: Four gigabytes of RAM and 2 TB of transfer for $9.38 is the best RAM-per-dollar ratio among evaluated providers after mivoCloud, and it is the only one of the seven listing a US west-coast location at the same price as its east-coast one; the 30 GB disk keeps it a front end or a control node, never a store.

limits.value: 2 TB a month on a 1 Gbps port, with 30 GB of SSD. The disk is the tighter of the two for an indexing role: the monthly transfer is about 68 times the disk's own size.
